title: Safari for Older Travellers
excerpt: Safari is a great holiday at any age. How to plan a comfortable trip for older travellers, with less driving and more rest.
body:
Many of our travellers are over 60, and a safari is a perfect trip for this stage of life.

## Comfort first

- Choose comfortable lodges and camps with good beds and easy access.
- Avoid long driving days by flying between parks. See [fly-in safaris](/blog/fly-in-safari/).
- Plan two or three nights per location.

## Pace

A private safari lets you set your own pace: later starts, longer breaks.

## Health

Talk to your doctor about vaccinations, malaria prevention and medication. Bring enough medication and copies of prescriptions.

## Mobility

Vehicles have a step to climb into. Tell us about limited mobility; see [accessible safari](/blog/accessible-safari/).

## Insurance

Check age limits and cover. See [travel insurance](/blog/tanzania-travel-insurance/).

## With grandchildren?

See [multi-generation safari](/blog/multi-generational-safari/).

[Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
